title.zh: 声音是怎么被造出来的

text.zh: 说话其实是一次被精细控制的呼气。同一股气流，出去时是叹息，稍加改造就成了句子。
text.en: Speaking is really a finely controlled exhalation. The same stream of air leaves as a sigh, and with a little reshaping it becomes a sentence.

text.zh: 改造发生在喉。这里的几块软骨搭成一个能开能合的框架，气流经过时被拨动成声。
text.en: The reshaping happens in the larynx, where a handful of cartilages build a frame that can open and close, setting the passing air vibrating.

text.zh: 最大的一块是甲状软骨，两片在前方合成一个角。这个角越尖越前突，从外面看就是喉结。
text.en: The largest piece is the thyroid cartilage, two plates meeting at an angle in front. The sharper and more forward that angle, the more visible the Adam's apple.

text.zh: 下面托着环状软骨，是整条气道里唯一一圈完整闭合的软骨环——别处都留着缺口。
text.en: Beneath it sits the cricoid cartilage, the only complete closed ring of cartilage in the entire airway; everywhere else the ring is left open.

text.zh: 上方立着会厌软骨。呼吸时它敞着，吞咽时立刻翻下来盖住喉口，把食物挡去食管那边。
text.en: Above stands the epiglottic cartilage. Open while you breathe, it folds down the instant you swallow, steering food across to the oesophagus instead.

text.zh: 声音的动力来自下面的气管。你能喊多久、喊多响，取决于这根管子里能推上来多少气。
text.en: The power comes from the trachea below. How long and how loudly you can shout depends on how much air this tube can push upward.

text.zh: 喉只造出一个嗡嗡的原声。真正把它切成词的是舌头——同一个音，舌位一变就成了另一个字。
text.en: The larynx only makes a raw buzz. What carves it into words is the tongue: keep the sound, move the tongue, and an entirely different syllable comes out.

text.zh: 一股气、几块软骨、一条舌头。你说的每一句话，都是这三样东西每秒配合好几次的结果。
text.en: One stream of air, a few pieces of cartilage, one tongue. Every sentence you speak is these three coordinating several times a second.
